functions.name: seekStream
functions.notes: Streambuf-style seek: max(+44,+24) position, embedded string at +32, direction 0 origin 0 and directions 1/2 origin current, signed offset bounded by [0,current]; flags 8 moves +12, flags 16 moves +24; result record gets offset+state or -1.

validation.comparison: 3 current positions x 4 directions x 4 flag states x 5 offsets compare complete memory and stack pointer.
limitations: Direction 2 uses the same origin as direction 1, matching the shipped branch table.
Ledger: 363 server bodies recovered and 371 remain machine code.
